about_the_game:
Stack Overflow is a fast-paced stacking game that challenges your precision and timing. Blocks move in from either side, and your goal is to tap at the perfect moment to align each block with the one beneath it. Misaligned portions are trimmed, adding a twist that makes every placement critical.

Key Features:
• Precise Timing: Enjoy simple controls that require skillful timing to place each block perfectly.
• Progressive Challenge: With each level, the speed increases and the margin for error decreases, keeping the gameplay engaging and intense.
• Intuitive Controls: Easy to learn and accessible for players of all ages.
• Vibrant Visuals & Audio: Crisp graphics and immersive sound effects enhance the stacking experience.

short_description: Stack Overflow is an addictive stacking game where perfect timing is key. Tap to drop moving blocks from the left or right and build your tower as high as possible—each block must land precisely to keep your tower intact.
